name: HalluLens
intro: HalluLens 以幻觉来源区分外在幻觉与内在幻觉：前者与训练数据中的世界知识不一致，后者与输入上下文不一致。其动态外在套件包含 PreciseWikiQA、LongWiki、MixedEntities 和 GeneratedEntities，共 15,200 个样本；内在分支整合 HHEM、ANAH 2.0 与 FaithEval 三个既有基准。
org: FAIR at Meta, GenAI at Meta, HKUST
build_method: 动态生成外在任务、整合既有内在幻觉基准
metric: False Refusal, Hallucinated When Not Refused, Correct Answer, Precision, Recall@32, F1@32, False Acceptance
task_type: 开放式问答, 生成, 事实验证, 分类, 安全测试
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 对抗性
scale: 15,200 个动态外在样本 + 3 个整合的内在幻觉基准
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Generation, Fact Verification, Classification, Safety Testing
build_method_en: Dynamic extrinsic-task generation plus integrated intrinsic benchmarks
intro_en: HalluLens classifies hallucinations by source: extrinsic hallucinations conflict with world knowledge represented in training data, while intrinsic hallucinations conflict with the input context. Its dynamic extrinsic suite contains PreciseWikiQA, LongWiki, MixedEntities, and GeneratedEntities for 15,200 samples; the intrinsic branch integrates the existing HHEM, ANAH 2.0, and FaithEval benchmarks.
scale_en: 15,200 dynamic extrinsic samples + 3 integrated intrinsic benchmarks
metric_en: False Refusal, Hallucinated When Not Refused, Correct Answer, Precision, Recall@32, F1@32, False Acceptance

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.17550, Sections 2-4. HalluLens separates extrinsic hallucinations inconsistent with training-data world knowledge from intrinsic hallucinations inconsistent with input context. The dynamic extrinsic suite totals 15,200 samples: PreciseWikiQA selects 5,000 questions from 44,754 GoodWiki pages across ten WikiRank difficulty bins; LongWiki builds 250 long-answer prompts with 50 items at each difficulty from 5 through 9; MixedEntities creates 8,000 nonexistent animal, plant, bacteria, and medicine names from ITIS and drug-name sources; GeneratedEntities creates 1,950 absent business, event, and product names through three-LLM round robin and Brave-search verification. Intrinsic evaluation integrates HHEM summarization, reference-backed ANAH 2.0, and FaithEval noisy/contradictory-context tasks rather than rebuilding them. Automated judges report task-specific refusal, correctness, long-form precision/Recall@32/F1@32, and false-acceptance metrics; LongWiki verification is Wikipedia-only.
